content: Overspending patterns: D&D forbids debt (hard cap). Threats & Trade-offs (2025, Information Systems Frontiers): negative budget -> draw investor card, else loan with interest and maturity tracked on a loan pad; cannot sell/downgrade defenses; unpurchased defenses increase in price. TOPSIM: automatic overdraft credit at penal interest (17%) repaid next period - linear, always more expensive than planning. Common pattern: overspend allowed only at a linear penal rate strictly above value gained; no refunds of sunk init cost.
